name: GenAI-Bench_image_edition_processed
description: GenAI-Bench_image_edition_processed is a processed dataset for evaluating image editing models on instructed edits. It pairs source images with textual edit instructions and target references to measure how well models follow edit prompts. The benchmark is intended to support both automated proxy metrics and human preference evaluations for edited outputs.
general_score_metric: human preference rate (often reported alongside CLIP similarity)
reputation: Relatively new/limited adoption dataset on Hugging Face aimed at practitioners working on generative image editing.
